title: ExternalAccountCreateRequest
description: Shared fields and validation for all ExternalAccount serializers.

routing_number.description: Routing number for the external account.

account_number.description: Account number for the external account.

product_type.description:
Account type, can be one of `checking`, `savings`, or `loan`.

* `checking` - Checking
* `savings` - Savings
* `loan` - Loan

account_purpose.description:
Specifies whether an external account is `personal` or `business`.

* `personal` - Personal
* `business` - Business

agreement.description: Whether the user has accepted the terms for account creation. This must be set to true for the account to be created successfully.

description.description: User-specific nickname for the account. This will be used as the display name of the account.
